definitions.explanation: Voluntarily giving up or not exercising a right, especially the right to vote.
Withdrawing from a competition, race, or match, usually due to injury or other circumstances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{棄権|きけん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{棄権|きけん}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}かった→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: The abstention rate was high in this election.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{棄権|きけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{危機感|ききかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I feel a sense of crisis about the increasing number of young people not voting.

examples.japanese: ⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{棄権|きけん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I withdrew due to an injury.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧{棄権|きけん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどく→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{棄権|きけん}⟦せざる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}なかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: The knee pain got so bad that I had no choice but to withdraw from the marathon.

notes:
USAGE:
{棄権|きけん} literally means "abandoning a right" ({棄|き} = discard, {権|けん} = right). It is used both in political contexts (not voting) and sports contexts (withdrawing from competition).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {棄権|きけん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to abstain / to withdraw
- {棄権|きけん}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: abstention rate
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧{棄権|きけん}: mid-event withdrawal
- {棄権|きけん}⟦{票|ひょう}→票：03582_hyou⟧: abstention vote

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{辞退|じたい}→辞退：03338_jitai⟧ is declining an offer or nomination before participating, while {棄権|きけん} is giving up a right or withdrawing after entry.
